info.title: DocRefract - PDF and DOCX Document Regression CLI
info.description: Open-source semantic PDF and DOCX diff CLI for deterministic document regression testing in CI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: DocRefract - deterministic semantic regression testing for PDF and DOCX.

commands.name: demo
commands.description: Generate sample DOCX files and an offline HTML/JSON report.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write diff.json and index.html to this directory.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Fail on any, or a comma-separated list of:
content, format, layout, media, visual, structure.
Default: any.

options.name: --json-only
options.description: Write diff.json without the HTML report.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version and exit.
Exit codes:
0  Comparison passed, or the demo completed successfully.
1  Comparison completed and prohibited changes were found.
2  Usage, input, or processing error.
